header.title: Principal statistics for all companies by industry grouping (import/export, wholesale and retail trades sector)
tablenote: The above statistics are compiled based on the Hong Kong Standard Industrial Classification (HSIC) Version 2.0. Users may also download past statistics based on HSIC Version 1.1 for reference.  Figures may not add up to the total due to rounding.  Percentage changes are derived from unrounded figures.
Figures for 2021 to 2022 include the amount of subsidy related to anti-epidemic measures.
[§3] Increase or decrease of less than 0.05%
